presumptions.regime: R3 only — no context; question carries its own setup; closed-book (§3.5.1)
presumptions.eval_frozen: pool C = 3 items, one per EVAL_SKILL, never grows (§1.4/§1.6)
presumptions.eval_vs_training: training spans 15 skills, eval probes 3 — deliberate; widening the training corpus was §1.6's remedy for cosine saturation
presumptions.cosine_gate: 0.80, never relaxed; max eval x train measured 0.798
presumptions.sft_rl_share_prompts: RL reuses pool B's prompts (§6.4) — convention, not leakage
presumptions.answer_length_cap: 476 tokens = box-cox(lam=0.5) median + 2*MAD*1.4826 over the 18 VibeThinker R3/general golds
presumptions.few_shot: homogeneous per-category blocks from eval_canonical.jsonl R3/general, seed 20260826; VibeThinker contributes STYLE only, no items
presumptions.known_imbalance: Code=21 vs Instruction=69/STEM=66/Math=45 — Code lagged because it was routed to the 9x-slower qwopus model for most of the run

partition.design: eval sized FIRST, remainder split EQUALLY 3 ways
partition.eval_weighting: VibeThinker measured R3 profile (R3_SHAPE_WEIGHTS), box-cox lam=0.5 -> PDF Math .331 / Code .254 / STEM .202 / Instruction .213
partition.phase_weighting: pool's own category mix, box-cox lam=0.5, allocated by DEFICIT-DRIVEN sampling across all 3 phases jointly: each draw goes to the (phase, category) cell furthest below its target ratio, recomputed after every draw. Sequential filling left RL with ZERO Code; round-robin fixed that but still drifted Math 15/16/7. Deficit-driven gives 12/13/13.
partition.why_equal_phases: an unequal split asserts a stage deserves more data — a claim no measurement supports. Phase ratio is an OPEN experimental variable to vary later with eval/seed held fixed (§1.5).
partition.rl_is_now_separate: RL no longer reuses SFT prompts; the three phases are disjoint, so RL lift cannot be confused with prompt re-exposure
partition.known_deviation: Code is thin everywhere (6/5/5 per phase) because only 21 Code items exist in the pool -- a generation-time deficit, not a partition artefact.
